digest.title: Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones
digest.tldr: ​Apple has backported security patches released last month to older iPhones and iPads, addressing a zero-day bug exploited in "extremely sophisticated" targeted attacks on iOS devices.
